title: Pawn Stars
description:
S01 E02 — Confederate Conundrum
A circa 1861 Civil War saber lands in the shop, but questions are raised about its authenticity; Fender guitar autographed by Chuck Berry; 1916 cash register.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E29 — The King's Bling
The guys are presented with a necklace once owned by Elvis Presley; a guy brings in a collection of over 200 vintage Matchbox cars; a man comes in with a pair of German Pickelhauben helmets from World War I.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E20 — American Hero
A helicopter flight helmet from the Vietnam War is brought in for restoration; Rick uses a 1940s Coke machine with lettering issues to teach Tyler a lesson.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E22 — Off the Wall
A man brings in a Civil War musket once carried by an ancestor wounded in battle; Corey sells an extremely rare movie poster from his personal collection; a rusted-out 1950s atomic missile-themed pedal car squeaks its way into the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E25 — Gold Diggers
A gold bar may be from a 1500s shipwreck; a celestial navigation dome from a B29 bomber; mint condition collection of American League baseball field passes.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E24 — Whale of a Time
An engraved whale's tooth may be authentic 19th-century scrimshaw; Civil War-era rifles; a pristine copy of Playboy's first issue.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E28 — Chumlee's Dummies
The Pawn Stars consider buying a 1939 Allied Forces World War II plane; the Old Man has a chance to buy a munitions receipt from the War of 1812, signed by Andrew Jackson; a man comes in with a pair of life-size western cowboy mannequins.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E33 — Teacher's Pet
The guys set their aim on a World War II bombsight; Corey and the Old Man check out a stock ticker from the 1930s; Chumlee teaches Antwaun about pawning.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E34 — Bugs Money
The team checks out a classic 1941 Indian motorcycle; a woman putters into the shop with a golf club once owned by Dean Martin; a seller arrives with a Bugs Bunny poster autographed by Mel Blanc.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E32 — Pirate's Booty
A street-legal pirate ship parade float cruises in; a woman drops in with a World War II bomber jacket and flight mission logs; Rick and the Old Man are presented with an antique carriage strong box.

title: American Pickers
description:
S06 E03 — Mike's Holy Grail
The guys get a vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes; Mike puts pressure on Danielle to track down a XAVW; Betty's sprawling warehouses; Dale's awesome junkyard and a noble cause.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E15 — Anchors Away
A 1952 powerboat ride splashes into the shop; Rick tackles a 1940s child's tricycle for a Las Vegas museum.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E03 — Wild Thing
An A6 Texan fighter plane is brought into the shop; a 1974 VW Thing cruises by; a guy brings in his collection of Civil War-era cannonballs.

title: 102 Minutes That Changed America
description: A first-person video and audio account of Sept. 11, 2001, featuring footage from numerous sources and in-the-moment commentary to provide a minute-by-minute record of that fateful day.

title: 9/11: Escape From the Towers
description: Survivors from two floors of the World Trade Center tell their stories; two men who volunteered to carry a stranger down 65 perilous flights of stairs; small group determined to get a pregnant co-worker to safety.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E05 — Landing Craft, Air Cushion Hovercraft (LCAC); U.S. Cavalry Saddles; Gas Masks
Operating the LCAC; cavalry saddles, used in the Old West; how gas masks work.

title: 15 Septembers Later
description: President George W. Bush, Vice President Dick Cheney, Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, and others provide a new perspective on the 9/11 terrorist attacks; the day's events are seen anew through the lens of declassified documents, photographs and information.
